purpose: Continue the same Nisyros IG01 archive-photo acquisition. First make two hash-verified review previews of existing acquired copies, then acquire only the six exact source photographs that previously failed. No voice, AI-image generation, credit-bearing research, final-video render, or social publishing.

manual_preflight.media_novelty_limit: Metricool rewrites original filenames; absence of source-name matches is not a full historic media-byte or visual identity proof. Target-topic history and current sourcepack acquisition state were also reviewed.
manual_preflight.enforcement_note: This is a root-reviewed asset-import authorization and external CAS lease binding. The existing image copier does not implement canonical production preflight or enforce this metadata; no production gate is enabled.
manual_preflight.duplicate_handling: The two acquired photographs are not imported again from Wikimedia and are not counted as new photos. Their review derivatives bind the exact acquired-copy SHA256. The six failed source jobs had no surviving imported media and are explicitly resumed under the same existing story.

retired_input_preservation.note: The retired Dog Bartender job is not copied or resumed; the entire current input is replaced with this unrelated existing-sourcepack photo-import batch.
